newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 4.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:
- An independent commission appointed by Congress will report on Wednesday that the government is overstating the inflation rate by 1.1 percentage points.
- The Clinton administration struggled Tuesday to convince the Supreme Court that the Brady gun control law is constitutional.
- New York Governor George Pataki announced his first nomination to the state's highest court, the Court of Appeals. Pataki chose pro-death-penalty Republican Richard Wesley.
- A Federal grand jury indicted three former officers of the Archer Daniels Midland Co on charges that they conspired with competitors to fix the prices of feed additive.
- A Circuit Court judge in Honolulu ruled that lawyers for the state had failed to show any compelling reason for the existing ban on gay and lesbian marriages.
